subject: Next steps and procurement path: OliveTech consideration
messages:
From: Charlotte Park <charlotte@olivetech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Reed <dan.reed@olivetech.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from demo + procurement questions

Hi Aditya / Lauren —

Thanks for the demo earlier today. That clarified a lot around inference latency and the dedicated capacity options. Before we surface this internally I have a few housekeeping items from the procurement and security side: 

- Can you share a one-page procurement path (billing contact, PO process, typical lead time)?
- Do you have a short pricing range for a pilot (250k tokens/month, single model) we can use for initial approvals?
- Our security team will need the questionnaire filled — attaching our RFP requirements (high level). Can you confirm who on your side owns that?

Also — we haven't identified a direct budget owner yet. At a minimum we need to state an approver for the pilot (finance or ML infra). Any suggestions on who we should route to?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Charlotte Park
Head of Data Platforms
OliveTech

Attachments: RFP_requirements.pdf (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Charlotte Park <charlotte@olivetech.com>, Dan Reed <dan.reed@olivetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo + procurement questions

Charlotte — thanks for the thoughtful notes and for hosting the demo. Quick recap + concrete next steps below so we have a shared plan.

Recap from our side:
- Pilot scope: inference for ranking pipeline, estimated 250k tokens/month for initial phase.
- Technical fit looks good for a Dedicated pool or a Hosted with reserved throughput.

Immediate asks (for OliveTech):
- Confirm procurement contact for PO and billing (name + email).
- Identify budget owner (title or person who approves pilot spend).
- Point security to the attached security questionnaire; Monica will own completion on our side.

What Redwood will deliver this week:
- MA plan (mutual action plan) with milestones and owners — attached (MA-Plan-olivetech.xlsx).
- Ballpark pricing for the pilot and two alternatives (hosted discounted commit vs. dedicated reserved) — attached (pricing-estimate-olivetech.pdf).
- Security questionnaire stub filled and a named contact (Monica Patel, CC'd).

Proposed timeline:
1) By Tue 3/30 — OliveTech confirms procurement contact + budget owner; Redwood returns completed questionnaire.
2) By Fri 4/2 — finalize pilot SOW and procurement docs; agree go/no-go date.

Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether we should route budget approval to Finance (CFO/Controller) or the ML Platform owner? If you prefer, I can draft an intro email to the approver.

Thanks — we'll keep this lightweight.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: MA-Plan-olivetech.xlsx (stub), pricing-estimate-olivetech.pdf (stub)

From: Dan Reed <dan.reed@olivetech.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Charlotte Park <charlotte@olivetech.com>, security@olivetech.com
Date: 2027-03-26T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo + procurement questions

Aditya —

Thanks. Procurement side notes:
- We'll need an estimated three-line spend summary for approvals (monthly run-rate, expected pilot term, one-time onboarding fees).
- Standard procurement wants to see SOC2 or equivalent and any data residency notes. Our security team (cc) will ping you with the questionnaire.
- For contracting, we prefer a master subscription agreement + PO rather than custom redlines for pilots.

Budget owner in our org is usually the Director of ML Infrastructure for projects like this; I'll check whether Finance needs to sign off as well (depends on pilot value).

Can you send the three-line summary and confirm whether Redwood can accept a standard PO billing flow?

Thanks,
Dan Reed
Sr. Procurement Manager, OliveTech

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-26T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: recommended approach for identifying econ buyer

Aditya / Monica — quick internal note (not for OliveTech yet).

Things that move this forward fast:
- Identify the 1-2 people who can sign a pilot (Director of ML Infra, Head of Data, or CFO for dollar sign approval). If Dan indicates Director of ML Infra, ask for name + availability for short intro call.
- Provide a 1-page ROI that shows cost avoidance vs. their current infra (monthly), and an expected time-to-value (weeks). Finance responds well to concrete run-rate numbers.
- Keep procurement happy with: three-line commercial summary, acceptance of PO, and SOC2 statement (or explicit next-step to provide cert).

Monica — please prepare a one-pager security summary and fill the security questionnaire draft. I recommend also preparing a short example PO template we can email to Dan.

Aditya — on your outbound to Charlotte/Dan, lead with: (a) who from OliveTech should approve the pilot and (b) ask whether they prefer Redwood to accept a PO or process via a marketplace invoice.

I'll be available to join the intro call if they want a director-level alignment.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Director, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Charlotte Park <charlotte@olivetech.com>, Dan Reed <dan.reed@olivetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: OliveTech pilot — procurement questions and next steps

Charlotte / Dan — following up on the plan below with two concrete asks so we can lock the pilot timeline.

1) Can you confirm the budget decision owner (name + title) we should route the pilot approval to? If uncertain, the Director of ML Infrastructure or Head of Data are typical; if Finance needs to sign, a PO is fine.

2) For procurement: would OliveTech prefer Redwood to accept a standard PO or to execute a short Master Subscription Agreement + PO? We can do either — PO-only is simplest for pilots.

To make approvals quick, I'm attaching:
- MA-Plan-olivetech.xlsx (milestones + owners)
- pricing-estimate-olivetech.pdf (three-line summary included)
- Monica will follow up with the security questionnaire (security-questionnaire-olivetech.xlsx)

If you can reply with: (A) budget owner contact and (B) preferred billing/PO flow, we can have a pilot SOW ready within 3 business days. Happy to draft the intro to the budget owner if you provide the contact.

Thanks again for your time — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

P.S. Lauren suggested I include a 1-page ROI; I'll attach that to the intro if helpful.
